card.name: Second digit inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (often 0, 8, 6 or 5) that is the middle or last digit of a number already begun, such as the 8 in 48 or the 0 in 40. Mostly in dose tables, volumes and counts.

modes.label: Digit in dose or volume figure
modes.description: A later digit in a number in dosing tables or amounts with mg, mL or mcg.

modes.label: Digit in other counts
modes.description: A later digit in chromosome counts, day ranges or old currency counts.

card.plain: It fires on the second or third digit of a number as it is being written out, mostly in dose tables.
